source_title: The Constitution of Ilorin Emirate Descendants Progressive Union (I.E.D.P.U), 2015

parts.title: Preamble
parts.text:
THE CONSTITUTION OF ILORIN EMIRATE DESCENDANTS PROGRESSIVE
                                   UNION (I.E.D.P.U), 2015.

      THE CONSTITUTION OF ILORIN EMIRATE DESCENDANTS PROGRESSIVE
                                             UNION

PREAMBLE:

We, members of the ILORIN EMIRATE DESCENDANTS PROGRESSIVE UNION,
recognizing the need to consolidate ourselves into an active, progressive and democratic body for
the progress and development of the Emirate and our people at home and abroad, appreciating
the problems of our Society and the role we must play in the maintenance of a united, democratic
and progressive Union and dedicating ourselves to work for the realization of these ideals as
enshrined in this Constitution firmly and solemnly resolved to have this Constitution.

parts.title: Section 1 — Name, Motto, Emblem and Secretariat
parts.text:
SECTION 1

(a)     NAME: The name of the Union shall be "ILORIN EMIRATE DESCENDANTS
        PROGRESSIVE UNION (I.E.D.P.U)".

(b)     MOTTO: The Motto of the Union shall be "Unity and Progress".

(c)     EMBLEM AND SEAL: The emblem of the Union shall be a Warrior in full regalia on a
        horse holding a spear in the left hand and a tasbih in the right hand with the inscription
        "ILORIN EMIRATE DESCENDANTS PROGRESSIVE UNION (I.E.D.P.U)" written
        around it.

(d)     SECRETARIAT: The Secretariat and the registered address of the Union shall be
        UMARU SARO ROAD, GARIN AL IMI ROUNDABOUT, ILORIN with Annex at No.
        146, KAMALDEEN STREET, PAKATA P.O. BOX 1127 ILORIN or at such other
        place(s) as the National Executive Council may determine from time to time, (e)       The
        Union shall be a NON-POLITICAL organization.

parts.title: Section 2 — Interpretation
Section 3 — Aims and Objectives
Section 4 — Membership and Rights
parts.text:
SECTION 4

(a)     MEMBERSHIP

(i)     Membership of the Union shall be open to every indigene of Ilorin Emirate resident in
        Nigeria and Abroad;

(ii)    To become an active member of the Union, an indigene shall upon being duly registered
        with a Branch of the Union be issued with a membership identity card by the National
        Executive Council.



(b)     RIGHTS AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS

        Financial members shall be entitled to all the rights and privileges of membership
        including the right to:

(i)     Vote and be voted for;

(ii)    Participate fully in debates at any meeting;

(iii)   Any other benefits/privileges as may be determined from time to time by the Union.

parts.title: Section 5 — Meetings of the Union
parts.text:
SECTION 5

MEETINGS OF THE UNION

Meetings of the Union shall be of four (4) categories: -

(a)     NATIONAL CONFERENCES:

(i)     Annual delegates conferences; and

(ii)    Emergency national conferences.



(b)     NATIONAL EXECUTIVE COUNCIL:

(i)     Weekly Executive Council meetings;


(ii)     Emergency Executive Council meetings.

(c)      ZONE:

(i)      Delegates meetings;

(ii)     Executive meetings;

(iii)    Annual general Convention; and

(iv)     Emergency meetings.

(d)      BRANCH:

(i)      Weekly general meetings;

(ii)     Executive meetings;

(iii)    Annual general meetings; and

(iv)     Emergency meetings.

parts.text:
SECTION 9

ELIGIBILITY      FOR    MEMBERSHIP OF THE NATIONAL

      EXECUTIVE COUNCIL

      For a member to be eligible for elective position on the National Executive Council of the
      Union, he must be:


(a)     an active and financial member of a registered branch of the Union;

(b)     recognized and nominated by a branch from a Zone;

(c)     found worthy in experience and character.

Section 12 — Offences and Disciplinary Measures
parts.text:
SECTION 12

OFFENCES AND DISCIPINARY MEASURES

(a)           OFFENCES

              The following shall constitute offences during the meeting or any activity of the Union:

       (i)       Acting in any capacity without due authority;
       (ii)      Use of abusive/derogatory/foul language;
       (iii)     Hooliganism
       (iv)      Fighting


       (v)       intoxication;
       (vi)      Fraudulent acts;
       (vii)     Refusal/hoarding/delay in handing over any property/records e Union in line with
                 provisions of this Constitution;
       (viii) Any behavior capable of distorting the peace and smooth conduct of the meeting or
                 activities of the Union;
       (ix)      Any acts capable of tarnishing the image and reputation of the Union.



(b)           DISCIPLINARY MEASURES

              The followings shall be the disciplinary/corrective measures, any of which may be taken
              against any officer or member found guilty of the offences listed in section 11(a) above:

(i)           WARNING: Written or verbal warning, which shall precede other disciplinary
              measures;

(ii)          SUSPENSION: A culpable member, Branch or Zone may be suspended from the Union
              for a period not less than three (3) months but not more than six (6) months for a first-
              time offender. Subsequent offences by the same member, Branch or Zone shall attract
              stiffer penalty as may be decided by the National Executive Council;

(iii)         EXPULSION: A recalcitrant offender shall be expelled only on the recommendation of
              the disciplinary committee subject to the ratification by two-third (2/3) majority of
              members present at the National Executive Council meeting where the recommendation
              is being considered;

       (iv)      Any expelled member, Branch or Zone shall not be eligible to participate in meetings
                 and other activities of the Union;
       (v)       Any expelled member, Branch or Zone snail only be eligible for a readmission into
                 the Union after two (2) years on expulsion and on the ground of appeal subject to the
                 ratification by two-third (2/3) majority of members present at the National Executive
                 Council meeting where the appeal is being considered.

Section 16 — Standing Orders, Validity and Amendment
parts.text:
(a)     STANDING ORDERS

(i)     Each Branch or Zone shall promulgate a set of rules and regulations called Standing
        Order/bye Laws to guide the operation of its meetings and other activities;

(ii)    Such Standing Order/bye Laws shall be null and void as much as they contradict this
        Constitution.


(b)     VALIDITY OF THE CONSTITUTION

(i)     The provisions of this Constitution shall be binding on all members. National Executive
        Council, Zones and Branches of the Union;

(ii)    No Branch or Zone shall have any other separate Constitution.



(c)     REVIEW AND AMENDMENT

(i)     This constitution shall be reviewed when necessary;

(ii)    Any amendment sponsored by any member, branch or zone shall be sent to the National
        executive council who shall upon receipt, constitute a constitution amendment/ review
        committee to consider the proposed amendment (s);

(iii)   Any approved amendment shall be circulated to all branches for preliminary information
        at least two months before the national conference;

(iv)    The National Executive council shall tender the approved amendment (s) at the national
        conference for consideration and adoption;

(v)     No national conference resolution to approve any proposed amendment to the
        constitution shall be deemed to have been passed unless it is supported by a majority of
        two-third (2/3) of delegates present, at the conference session.

parts.title: Section 17 — Special Clause
parts.text:
SECTION 17

(a)     SPECIAL CLAUSE

(i)     THE INCOME AND PROPERTY of the Ilorin Emirate Descendants Progressive Union
        (I.E.D.P.U) where so ever derived shall be applied solely towards die promotion of the
        objectives of the Union as set forth in this Constitution and no portion thereof shall be
        paid or transferred directly or indirectly by way of dividend, bonus or otherwise however
        by way of profit to the members of the Ilorin Emirate Descendants Progressive Union;


(ii)    PROVIDED that nothing herein shall prevent the payment in good faith of reasonable
        and proper remuneration to any officer or servant of the Union but so that no member of
        the Council of Management or Governing Body shall be appointed to any salaries office
        of the Union or any office of the Union paid by fees, and that no remuneration or other
        benefits in money or monies shall be given by the Union to any member of such Council
        or Governing Body except repayment of out of pocket expenses or reasonable and proper
        rent for premises demised or let to the Union provided that the provision last aforesaid
        snail not apply to any payment of any company to a member of the Union may be a
        company in which such member shall not hold more than one hundredth part of the
        capital and such member shall not be bound on account for any share of profits he may
        receive in respect of any such payment;

(iii)   NO ADDITION, alteration or amendment shall be made to or in the Constitution for the
        time being in force, unless the same have been previously submitted to and approve by
        the Registrar General; In the event of a winding up or dissolution of the Ilorin Emirate
        Descendants Progressive Union (I.E.D.P.U) if there remains after the satisfaction of all its
        liabilities, any property whatsoever the same shall not be appropriated to or distributed
        among the members of the Union but shall be given or transferred to some other
        institution or institutions having objects similar to the objects of the Union and the body
        or bodies are prohibited from distributing its or their income and property amongst its or
        their members to an extent at great as is imposed on the Union under or by virtue of the
        SPECIAL CLAUSE hereof, such institution or institutions to be determined by the
        members of the Union if effect cannot be given to the aforesaid provision then to some
        charitable objects.

parts.title: Second Schedule — Oath of Office
parts.text:
SECOND SCHEDULE

OATH OF OFFICE OF ELECTED OFFICERS/MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL
EXECUTIVE COUNCIL

I………………………………………………………………………………………...do solemnly
swear/affirm that I will be faithful and bear true allegiance to the ILORIN EMIRATE
DESCENDANTS PROGRESSIVE UNION; that as ________________________________I
will discharge my duties to the best of my ability, faithfully and in accordance with the
Constitution of IEDPU and the Law, and always in the interest of the Union, integrity, solidarity,


wellbeing and prosperity of the Union and Ilorin as a whole; that I will strive to preserve the
integrity and culture of Ilorin; that I will not allow my personal interest to influence my official
conduct or my official decisions; that in all circumstances, I will do right to all manner of people
according to Law without fear or favor, affection or ill will; that I will not directly or indirectly
communicate or reveal to any person any matter which shall become known to me as

……………………………………………………………………...except as may be required for

the due discharge of my duties as………………………………………………………………….

and that I will devote myself to the service and wellbeing of the people of Ilorin.

So, help me God.

parts.title: Citation, Commencement and Signatures
parts.text:
CITATION
       This Constitution may be cited as the Constitution of ILORIN EMIRATE
       DESCENDANTS PROGRESSIVE UNION (IEDPU), 2015.


COMMENCEMENT
       This Constitution as amended shall come into effect on the 19th day of April. 2015.
